{{Quote|Be advised that even after you are freed, one shackle band will remain in place. It carries a fatal ''ion charge'' that we can trigger remotely at the first ''hint'' of disobedience.|[[Klysk]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref>}}
'''Energy shackles''' were a wearable device. These shackles usually had blue energy illuminating them. The shackles worn by [[Galen Marek]] allowed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] influence to haunt him via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], perhaps to control him, or simply to sense his location.
